cases.description: JSON payload containing __proto__, constructor, or prototype keys must be rejected without mutating Object prototype
Deeply nested JSON object exceeding 32 levels must be aborted before stack overflow
cases.expected_error: Document is too complex to preview.

cases.description: JSON document with excessive keys (>20000 items) must be rejected to prevent denial of service
cases.expected_error: Document is too complex to preview.

cases.description: File exceeding maximum preview byte limit (64 KiB) must be rejected before parsing
Field names containing HTML tags and script execution vectors must be safely text-escaped in the DOM
Uploaded file names containing script tags must be safely rendered as text without DOM execution
Requesting metadata for an unauthorized or foreign vault must fail closed with 403 Access Denied
Attempting transient secret reveal without step-up token must be rejected
cases.expected_error: Step-up token is required for transient reveal.

cases.description: Revoked member attempting secret reveal must be denied immediately
Secret path with directory traversal sequences (../, //) must be rejected before storage lookup

When upstream KMS / OpenBao is unreachable or returns 503, operations must fail closed with explicit error and zero plaintext leaked
Corrupted envelope ciphertext or invalid GCM authentication tag must fail closed with authentication error; zero partial bytes returned
